ko.executive_summary: SK hynix overhauled its recruiting process to prioritize AI-era talent, eliminating academic credentials as barriers and introducing half-day intensive interviews to evaluate fundamental thinking. The company is conducting nationwide briefings and executing a 40 trillion won buyback while planning H2 recruitment.
key_facts: SK hynix: Eliminated education requirement in job postings
SK hynix: Introduced half-day intensive interview format
SK hynix: 40 trillion won (with Shinhan Investment) for early share buyback execution
SK hynix: Planning H2 open recruitment of new hires
SK hynix: Conducting nationwide talent briefings
Google: Expects AI agents to automate data preparation, hiring hundreds of engineers

implications.text: Removal of education credentials signals shift toward skills-based hiring as AI capabilities accelerate demand for specialized engineers
SK hynix nationwide briefing campaign and H2 recruitment push indicate substantial headcount expansion for AI workloads
Early 40 trillion won buyback execution may signal confidence in HPC/AI DRAM demand trajectory

ko.counterpoint: Hiring ramp details (specific headcount targets, engineering specializations) and timeline for interview process rollout not specified.

ko.executive_summary: Major cloud and autonomous vehicle companies are building custom AI chips to reduce compute costs and NVIDIA reliance: Google inked a $12.2B equity warrant deal with Marvell and achieved first-time TPU chip revenue, Waymo disclosed a 5nm TSMC automotive chip with 1,000+ TOPS, and Anthropic is developing in-house chips targeting $19B compute cost reduction. South Korea announced plans for 2 additional chip fabs in Honam region by 2040, while RAG cost optimization techniques using smaller model filtering are gaining adoption on Amazon Bedrock.
key_facts: Google: $12.2B equity warrant tied to Marvell TPU deal
Google: TPU chips generated revenue for first time last quarter
Waymo: 5nm TSMC custom automotive chip with 1,000+ TOPS AI processing
Waymo: Custom chip deployed in every robotaxi
Anthropic: Developing custom AI chips; compute costs at $19B
South Korea: Planning 2 additional chip fabs in Honam region (6+ fabs by 2040 nationwide)
Amazon Bedrock: Query-aware compression pattern reduces RAG input tokens and cost

implications.text: Google, Waymo, and Anthropic moving beyond NVIDIA GPU dependence signals industry-wide custom silicon strategy to optimize TCO and performance for specific workloads
TSMC 5nm and 2nm demand from custom chip initiatives (Waymo, Intel Razor Lake on N2X) tightens leading-edge capacity allocation
South Korea's Honam fab expansion targets AI chip sovereignty; positioning against geopolitical constraints on advanced node access
Query-aware RAG compression and custom chip designs indicate AI operating cost as primary competitive lever alongside performance

ko.counterpoint: South Korea's fab expansion timeline (2040) is distant; near-term capacity constraints likely persist as custom chip demand accelerates.

ko.executive_summary: Foundry capacity tightens as AI demand accelerates pricing power: Samsung implemented up to 15% foundry price hikes, STMicroelectronics planned third 2026 price increase with power device lead times hitting 52 weeks, and TSMC reported 36% sales jump while raising 2026 CapEx and dividends. Rapidus targets 8-reticle interposers on 600mm panels by 2030, while Intel's Razor Lake may adopt TSMC's 2nm N2X process.
key_facts: Samsung Foundry: Up to 15% price hike
STMicroelectronics: Third price hike planned for August 2026; 52-week power device lead times
TSMC: 36% YoY sales growth
TSMC: Higher CapEx committed for 2026; dividend payout raised
TSMC: 1.6nm A16 process development complete; mass production Q4
Rapidus: Targeting 8-reticle interposers with 600mm panels by 2030
Intel Razor Lake: Reportedly using TSMC 2nm N2X process

implications.text: Samsung's 15% price hike and STMicroelectronics third hike confirm foundry margin expansion driven by AI workload demand outpacing supply
52-week power device lead times and tightened foundry capacity force customers to secure allocation via pricing tolerance
Intel Razor Lake N2X adoption reinforces TSMC's 2nm leadership; TSMC capital intensity rising (higher CapEx) to sustain node cadence
Rapidus 600mm interposer roadmap addresses chiplet interconnect bottlenecks as 2nm-era designs split across multiple dice

ko.counterpoint: TSMC's dividend raise amid CapEx increase may signal confidence, but 1.6nm A16 mass production timing (Q4) carries execution risk.
